propositions: transition_core declares force_close_reason parameter but never reads it, silently discarding the operator-supplied --force reason value
force_close_reason is passed by transition_close.py:474 but does not appear in the close STATUS event data structure (only status, current_status, parent_status_uuid, close_class are recorded)
the current audit comment path for force-close reasons is unreliable under contention because it requires a second lock acquisition after the close, which can timeout and lose the reason
force_close_reason should be written into the close STATUS event as a present-only field, mirroring close_class, and folded into reduced state at both *->closed transition edges
a close without --force must omit the force_close_reason key entirely to remain byte-identical to pre-change events for backward compatibility
